author: Cinna Davis (substantial AI assistance)
statement: A charge-dependent local length rescaling gives a new scalar-filter space. Complete exact finite classifications on the registered PR 19 codebooks find full-rank filtered crossings at h=4 after removing central shifts through absolute value 3 and at h=6 through absolute value 2. The h=6 cutoff 5 and maximal cutoffs are singular in these finite spaces. A full-weight-space h=4 control retains rank four at cutoff 1 and only rank one at cutoff 3. No all-size filter, leading-capacity proof, smaller rho or improved SAT exponent is obtained.
remaining_obligations: All-size scalarity and full-rank existence for a constant-fraction central shift filter
Leading row, column and output codebook capacity
Polynomial piece count, uniform entry generation, coefficient heights and both directional rank envelopes
Complete rational transfer and master recursion composition
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance; no independent or formal review
